name: singular-orchestration
description: Operate Singular (CLI: gluerun) multi-agent orchestration — author DAG plans, run autonomous parallel agent loops, and monitor L0/L1/L2 state through the read-only console/dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Singular (gluerun) agents, plans, tasks, gates — with a live dashboard/console viewer.
interface.longDescription: An operator skill plus read-only local console (dashboard/viewer/visualization UI, started idempotently with `gluerun console --ensure`) for Singular (formerly glueRun-go) orchestration. The skill teaches an agent to set up a repo, author parallel DAG plans and planner contracts, run the autonomous loop at maximum parallelization, promote gates, and recover stuck runs. The bundled console shows a top status/control bar (health, STOP, drift, frontier, active counts, disk, gates), a main L0 to L1 to L2 graph viewport with agents and list views, and an inspector drawer that drills into any task — objective, owned and forbidden files, acceptance criteria, required evidence, lease metadata, run id, worktree existence, packets, integration audit, and task-scoped events. Deployed sub-agents are derived from durable facts only.
defaultPrompt: Run the Singular orchestration on this repo.
Open the Singular orchestration console and show L0/L1/L2 status.
